jubilee.line: Ah, they're dancing in the street—it's Jubilee
stanza: Ah, they're dancing in the street—it's Jubilee
We sold ourselves for love but now we're free
I'm so sorry for that ghost I made you be
Only one of us was real and that was me

jubilee.line: Until I ride "The Gospel Ship to Heaven's Jubilee"
stanza: And we sang "Sweet Rose of Sharon, Abide With Me"
Until I ride "The Gospel Ship to Heaven's Jubilee"
And "In That Great Triumphant Morning" my soul will be free
And "My Burdens Will Be Lifted" when my Saviour's face I see

jubilee.line: Come with me and we'll attend their jubilee
stanza: Come with me and we'll attend their jubilee
And see them spend their last two bits
